compatibility_exception.rationale: R6 used a later harness snapshot whose archived diff adds direct-baseline routing support and conditional validation/finalization branches. The Switchyard execution branch, dataset, task policy, model/router/pricing configuration, Relay wheel, Switchyard binary, concurrency, and timeouts remain the same as R4/R5; the grouped estimate therefore remains useful but is not an exact-signature replicate set.

excluded_groups.reason: The three preserved escalation cohorts do not currently have complete 89-task observations and therefore do not satisfy the requested N=3 final-analysis admission gate.
Superseded staged cohorts contain the diagnosed classifier tool-history integration blocker and are not valid scientific trials.

analysis_contract.primary_variation: sample standard deviation across three run-level observations
analysis_contract.cost_baseline: mean observable covered execution-model cost across the three Opus 4.8 direct baseline runs
analysis_contract.paired_comparison: task-aligned per-configuration pass frequencies with a bootstrap interval over tasks; replicate indices are not treated as natural pairs
primary_plots: configuration mean pass@1 bars with individual runs and sample-standard-deviation error bars
configuration mean cost bars with individual runs and sample-standard-deviation error bars
aligned two-panel cost and performance comparison sharing the configuration axis
